Visceral Pulse.name: Visceral Pulse
Visceral Pulse.description: The user's signature move: they release a deep vocal pulse that couples sound with an inner-body tremor across a room's width. Every enemy there takes massive sonic and bludgeoning damage and drops to their knees with nausea, unable to stand or act until the end of their next turn; held back, it only stuns them without sickness. Afterward the user cannot hear or speak until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
